about: Answers where careful readers still split after the labelling rules were applied, and Anton accepted that the text supports two values. The key carries one of them; when anything is scored against the key, either accepted value counts as right on that question. An entry is a result, not an open question: it is not argued again unless a rule changes. Anton's words per entry are in golden/verdicts.md.
